none: PAS NLM-B311B4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTAN] TINOPOL[IS]. Reverse description: probably Victory advancing left on prow. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.92gms, die axis: possibly 6
